def get(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
        """Get configuration value with validation.

        Results are memoized per (key, default) pair: the fetch pipeline
        reads ~10 config keys per payload, so validation ran thousands of
        times per large batch. ``set()`` clears the memo.
        """
        try:
            memo_key = (key, default)
        except TypeError:  # unhashable default: skip memoization
            memo_key = None
        if memo_key is not None:
            cached = self._validated.get(memo_key, _MISSING)
            if cached is not _MISSING:
                return cached
        result = self._validate_and_get(key, default)
        if memo_key is not None:
            self._validated[memo_key] = result
        return result

    def _validate_and_get(self, key: str, default: Any) -> Any:
        """Validate and return one configuration value."""
        value = self._config.get(key, default)

def set(self, key: str, value: Any):
        """Set configuration value."""
        self._config[key] = value
        self._validated.clear()
